home.title: My Albums
home.subtitle: Collect stickers, open timed packs, trade duplicates.
home.framePreviewHint: Each album has its own frame.css — art loads on top later (lazy).

settings.title: Settings
settings.syncHint: Pull catalog and album files from CDN (or use bundled content offline).
settings.languageHint: English and Portuguese are available in the MVP.
settings.enabledAlbumsHint: Disabled albums are excluded when you open packs (Phase 4).

trade.title: Trade duplicates
trade.disclaimer: Trades are local and trust-based. Only trade with people you know.
trade.pendingIncoming: Pending — confirm when your partner completes
trade.noDuplicates: No duplicates to trade yet. Open more packs!
trade.selectCounterOffer: Tap duplicates you give in return
trade.useCopyNotQr: Large offer — copy the payload instead of QR
trade.pasteHint: Paste or enter a trade payload from your partner
trade.ackHint: Send this ack to the offer creator so they can confirm on their device
trade.copyPayloadAgainHint: Payloads are saved on this device. You can copy again while not expired.
trade.savedInTradeLog: Saved in Trade — you can copy the payload again from the trade hub.
trade.trustLimitNote: Without a server, anyone with the payload can try to accept. This app blocks reuse on your device after a trade completes; confirm only one partner ack.
trade.registryOnline: Global trade protection: online (one accept per offer worldwide)
trade.registryOffline: Trade registry configured but unreachable — local rules only
trade.registryNotConfigured: No trade registry URL in this build — local trust only

admin.unlockHint: Enter your unlock phrase (not stored in the app).
admin.unlockError: Invalid phrase or admin not configured in build.
admin.notConfigured: Admin unlock is not configured for this build.
admin.toolsHint: Local testing only. Changes stay on this device.

about.tagline: Sticker album MVP — offline-first, no backend.
about.madeWith: Built with Expo & Spec Driven Development

errors.bootstrapFailed: Could not load album content. Check your connection or reinstall the app.

pack.notReady: Pack is not ready yet. Please wait for the cooldown.
pack.poolTooSmall: Not enough stickers in the pool. Enable more albums or wait for content updates.
pack.noEnabledAlbums: No albums enabled. Go to Settings to enable at least one album.

trade.insufficientDuplicate: You don't have enough duplicates of the offered sticker.
trade.invalidPayload: Invalid trade payload. Check and try again.
trade.wantedNotInCatalog: The wanted sticker is not in your enabled albums.
trade.offeredNotInCatalog: The offered sticker is not in your enabled albums.
trade.insufficientWanted: You do not have the sticker you would give in this trade.
trade.tooManyStickers: Too many stickers selected (max 100 per side).
trade.alreadyUsedLocally: This offer was already completed on this device.
trade.ownOffer: You cannot accept your own offer.
trade.alreadyClaimedGlobally: This offer was already accepted by someone else (global registry).
trade.registryError: Trade registry rejected this offer. Try again or ask for a new payload.
